Package com.sca4d.core.api.call

Interface CallLifecycle.Around

All Known Implementing Classes:
AuditCallInterceptor, IdempotencyCallInterceptor, IdentityCallInterceptor, LockCallInterceptor, PermissionCallInterceptor, RateLimitCallInterceptor
Enclosing class:
CallLifecycle
public static interface CallLifecycle.Around
包围剩余方法执行；允许明确重放或拒绝，不能隐式吞掉内层失败。
